note: Vocabulary of the mod: the groups of types (a servant has one type of each group), each type with its color (or its family color) and its emblem, and the keywords with their icons. Emblems are SVG (viewBox 24x24) where {c} is the main color and {b} the background color. Names and rule reminders are in the texts of the mod (type.*, keyword.*, kwdesc.*). icons: the other emblems of the game (resource, buttons), by the names that game.json and the screens use.
